e1758.pitch: It's 5:58 PM. The bus leaves at 6:00. Get from your desk to the exit before a manager hands you <q>one more quick task</q>.
e1758.body: A third-person stealth comedy about the most dangerous two minutes of the workday. Managers patrol, coworkers snitch, the elevator breaks down.
e1758.body2: We designed and built it end to end — gameplay, AI, adaptive music, localization and a cross-platform build pipeline — and we're getting it ready for Steam on PC.
e1758.cap1: 5:58 PM, still at your desk. Your coworker has opinions.
e1758.cap2: The elevator is out. A trash can makes a decent plant.

databairro.pitch: Real estate decisions backed by real data.
databairro.body: DataBairro is a real estate intelligence platform that estimates apartment market values in São Paulo using actual property transaction data rather than asking prices.
databairro.body2: Built from the ground up, it transforms over 1.3 million property transaction records into actionable insights through geospatial analysis, automated data pipelines and statistical valuation models.
databairro.pt1d: ETL pipelines download the city's public records, validate them, link each transaction to the property register and screen out sales that don't reflect the market.
databairro.pt2d: 1,333,581 ITBI transaction records from 2019 to 2026, alongside the municipal property register.
databairro.pt3d: PostgreSQL and PostGIS place each address on the city's lot map and measure what's around it: transit, schools, health care and flood risk.
databairro.pt4d: Up to eight comparable sales — same building first, then nearby — and the median price per square meter, applied to the unit's registered area.
databairro.pt5d: Every estimate comes as a range with a confidence level. When the evidence is thin, DataBairro says so instead of guessing.
databairro.pt6d: From data pipelines and database to API, web app and production infrastructure.
databairro.disclaimer: Estimates are statistical references based on declared transactions, not formal appraisals.
databairro.cap1: The query: an address in São Paulo and, optionally, the unit. The app is in Portuguese.
databairro.cap2: The result: a range, a central value and the confidence behind it.
databairro.cap3: The evidence: the comparable sales the estimate came from.
databairro.cap4: Architecture as built: from public records to an answer.
databairro.spec_scope_v: City of São Paulo — value references for apartments

about.label: 03 / About
about.title: Built by experience. Driven by curiosity.
about.p1: MAEDODEAM was founded by Roger Maedo, a software engineer with about twenty years of building systems that run in production.
about.p2: Most of that time went into the hard, invisible parts: backends, architecture, integrations, distributed and enterprise systems — and leading the engineering behind them.
about.p3: MAEDODEAM is where that experience gets to build things of its own: independent products, games, experiments, and collaborations on problems that are actually interesting.
about.p4: Small on purpose. Fewer layers, more things that actually ship.
